semiconductor_relevance: High — ATLANT 3D Nanosystems specializes in advanced material deposition technologies that are critical for semiconductor fabrication.
summary: ATLANT 3D Nanosystems is a deep tech start-up focused on revolutionizing microfabrication through its proprietary Direct Atomic Layer Processing (DALP®) technology. Their Nanofabricator Lite enables atomic-scale precision in material deposition, allowing for the rapid prototyping of complex micro and nanodevices with unprecedented geometries.
capabilities: Atomic layer 3D printing for micro and nanodevices
